description: Add a tested function to an existing module and use it to produce a report.

contract.objective: Add a function restock_report(items, *, multiplier=2) to inventory.py. It returns a list of (sku, order_quantity) tuples for items whose quantity is at or below their reorder_level, where order_quantity = reorder_level * multiplier - quantity, sorted by order_quantity descending and then by sku ascending. multiplier must be keyword-only. Add unit tests for it to test_inventory.py and keep the existing tests passing. Finally write restock.txt with the report for items.csv, one line per item formatted as sku,order_quantity.
acceptance_criteria: test_inventory.py tests restock_report and all tests pass
restock.txt lists the report for items.csv
